In Healthcare & Life Sciences, data, analytics & lakehouse is the substrate tower: pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture on databricks and snowflake, streaming and event-driven decisioning, executive bi, master data and cataloging, predictive analytics, and data products that generate revenue. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: data engineering & pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture & migration, real-time streaming & event-driven decisioning — delivered on Achala Forge and Achala Nexus with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Interoperability gaps despite FHIR mandates
Imaging, genomics, claims and social determinants live in separate estates; exchange compliance is achieved technically but decision support still reads silos.
Trial recruitment and RWE pipelines manual
Protocol eligibility matching against EHR data remains chart-review work; real-world evidence assemblies take months per study.
Clinician burden and documentation debt
Physicians spend hours daily on notes, orders and inbox; burnout drives attrition. Documentation AI exists but stalls on integration with the EHR and on compliance sign-off.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

The delivery pattern composes 7 services from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower — Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization, Lakehouse Architecture & Migration, Real-Time Streaming & Event-Driven Decisioning, Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics as the usual core — sequenced through the Achala Method with sector controls: HL7 FHIR / TEFCA-style exchange obligations shape the design from the first sprint.
